name: Ray-Bomb (GIM52A)
doc: Ray-Bomb (GIM52A's enemy attack; module 313 is Ray-Bomb 10's code with another timeline): a muzzle in front of the caster charging, dust blown from it, a muzzle flash, two beams to the targets spinning both ways with their sparks, smoke, a shockwave ring and debris at the targets, the party thrown up and bounced back. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag313_ray_bomb.cpp) run on the program's memory.

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Timing
parts.doc: The director's timeline: its sound, the screen flash, its end (draws nothing)

parts.title: Charge
parts.doc: The muzzle in front of the caster, its charge glows and the dust blown from it

parts.title: Muzzle flash
parts.doc: A prim model at the muzzle, shrinking

parts.title: Beam
parts.doc: The two beams from the muzzle to the targets, spinning both ways, their sparks

parts.title: Blast
parts.doc: Smoke puffs, the shockwave ring and debris at the targets

parts.title: Bounce
parts.doc: The party thrown up and bounced back (the damage on the targets)

groups.label: Muzzle
groups.doc: From the caster's effect point, turned with it: Up, Back

groups.label: Dust
groups.doc: From the muzzle, ticks First to Last: Count a tick (at most 3), speed Speed + rand % Spread, size Size + rand % Size spread

groups.label: Smoke
groups.doc: Ticks First to Last: 1-2 puffs at 5 spots, scale Scale + rand % Spread (the texture restored at First)

groups.label: Debris
groups.doc: Ticks First to Last: 2-3 pieces at 5 spots thrown up by Speed + rand % Spread

params.label: Muzzle sound
params.doc: Played at its tick

params.label: Flash in
params.doc: The screen flashes up until this tick...

params.label: Flash out
params.doc: ...and down from this one to the end

params.label: End
params.doc: The attack ends after this tick

params.label: Glows tick
params.doc: The charge glows start at this tick...

params.label: Glows
params.doc: ...this many

params.label: Glow scale
params.doc: Each glow's scale at its start (4096: its own size)

params.label: Glow growth
params.doc: Each glow grows by this a tick

params.label: Glow size
params.doc: Its size: this + rand % Glow size spread

params.label: Tick
params.doc: The muzzle flash at this tick

params.label: Scale
params.doc: Its scale (4096: its own size)...

params.label: Shrink
params.doc: ...down by this a tick

params.label: Tick
params.doc: The two beams at this tick

params.label: Tick
params.doc: The party thrown up at this tick

params.label: Dust

params.label: Puff
params.doc: The sprite sequence puff (a flipbook of 1 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Texture file
